verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents that you can export directory events data through RESTful commands (docs-4), and its API GET endpoints can traverse the graph to return all directly and indirectly bound objects (docs-25). That is only a narrow, API-driven route rather than a documented full-account export. Missing for 10: a first-party bulk export of all data (users, devices, policies, vault contents) in documented open formats, migration or offboarding guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete data exit.
